mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.rule_id, d.row_num, d.funds_type, d.subject_code, d.account_scope, d.debit_credit, d.currency, d.is_unilateral, d.extend_script, d.summary, d.create_time, d.update_time, d.is_delete, d.tenant_id FROM t_accounting_rule_detail d LEFT JOIN t_accounting_rule_auxiliary a ON d.id = a.rule_detail_id AND a.is_delete = 0 WHERE d.rule_id = #{ruleId} AND d.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY d.row_num ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_accounting_rule_detail SET is_delete = id WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND is_delete = 0
